title: Cinema Projectionist
description: A man in a grey jumpsuit stands in a dilapidated vintage movie theater, holding a small object while looking at a large projection screen displaying silhouettes and film reel mechanisms. The floor is cluttered with glowing green film reels, broken clapperboards, and debris, with old theater seats, a film camera on a tripod, and a 'LEVEL 7 PROJECTION' sign visible.
prompt: A lone projectionist in a grey jumpsuit stands inside a decaying ornate cinema with a painted celestial ceiling. He faces a large screen showing film machinery and dancing silhouettes. The floor is covered in scattered glowing green film reels, broken clapperboards, and debris. A vintage film camera stands on a tripod beside red curtains and a Level 7 Projection sign. Cinematic lighting with a strong projector beam cutting through dusty air, moody and atmospheric digital painting.
